source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the thyroid gland (PDF 63-64).

blocks.text: Thyroid titli-numa gland hai jis ke do jure lobes gardan ke aage trachea ke dono taraf hain. Ise aksar jism ke metabolism ka master controller kaha jata hai, kyunke is ke hormones tay karte hain ke har cell kitni tezi se kaam kare.

items: Thyroxine (tetra-iodothyronine, T4) aur tri-iodothyronine (T3): thyroid T4 bohat zyada banata hai jo T3, zyada faal shakal, mein badalta hai. Yeh dil aur saans ki raftar barhate, cellular respiration tez karte aur basal metabolic rate tay karte, jigar mein glucose ka tootna aur cholesterol banna barhate, aur bachon mein dhanche ki nashonuma aur dimagh ki tarqi mein madad dete hain.
Calcitonin: khoon mein calcium munasib rakhne mein madad deta hai; jab khoon ka calcium bohat barh jaye to calcium ko haddiyon mein le jata aur khoon mein us ki satah kam karta hai.
Hypothyroidism (kam): nashonuma ka rukna, susti, wazan barhna, qabz, zyada cholesterol, kam dharkan aur kam darja-e-hararat.
Cretinism: janeen aur bachpan mein hypothyroidism, jo rukti nashonuma aur zehni pasmandagi la'ta hai.
Myxoedema: shadeed hypothyroidism ka kam magar jaan leva nateeja, jis mein connective tissue mein mucopolysaccharides jama ho kar jild aur tissues ko soojha aur mota kar dete hain.
Goitre: jab hypothyroidism iodine ki kami se ho to thyroid ka soojna.
Hyperthyroidism (zyada): wazan ghatna aur zyada blood pressure, dharkan aur darja-e-hararat.

blocks.title: Graves' disease
blocks.text: Graves' disease aik autoimmune bimari hai jo hyperthyroidism paida karti hai, aksar bare thyroid ke saath. Alamaat mein chirchirapan, muscles ki kamzori, neend ke masail, tez dharkan, garmi bardasht na hona, dast, wazan ghatna aur pindliyon ki jild mota hona shamil hain; aankhein bahar ubhar sakti hain (exophthalmia).

blocks.prompt: Iodine ki kami goitre kyun kar sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Thyroid hormones banane ke liye iodine zaroori hai (un ke naam tri- aur tetra-iodo iodine atoms dikhate hain). Kaafi na ho to hormones kam (hypothyroidism) aur gland soojh jata hai. (TSH wala rabta aam biology hai.)

items: Thyroid: T4 aur T3 metabolic rate tay karte aur nashonuma mein madad dete; calcitonin khoon ka calcium kam karta.
Kam: hypothyroidism, cretinism, myxoedema, goitre; zyada: hyperthyroidism (Graves' disease).
